fichas.title: Office Building Grids and Adaptable Modules
fichas.summary: Grid modules coordinate columns, façades, partitions, and room sizes. Fitting-out and façade grids should align, while structural grids may be offset at the cost of usable room space. The page compares economical modules for single-room and combi-offices, illustrates uses for different window-axis dimensions, and discusses acoustic detailing at partition junctions, façades, ceilings, and floors.
uses: Coordinate partitions with façade and structural grids
Accommodate varied workstation and meeting arrangements
Reduce sound transfer at partition junctions
